title: Cardinal E1 — One case never defines the system
says: A case is a conformance case, never the architecture's target: it either fits a declared rule, or the rule is extended generically and versioned. No special case lives in the core; each request forces a more general, provable level.
publisher: agent-kit (generic engineering doctrine, distilled from GeoStat's engineering quality doctrine)

title: Cardinal E2 — Source facts are immutable
says: An external fact is interpreted, never replaced. A correction is a separate, audited fact beside it -- who, when, why, the original value -- and a derived result is the original plus the approved corrections, so a rollback is trivial.
publisher: agent-kit (generic engineering doctrine, distilled from GeoStat's engineering quality doctrine)

title: Cardinal E3 — Under uncertainty, refuse
says: What cannot be decided is refused, never defaulted. A blocker stops the work that depends on it; independent work continues.
publisher: agent-kit (generic engineering doctrine, distilled from GeoStat's engineering quality doctrine)

title: Cardinal E4 — Proven, not claimed
says: Done is a test and its evidence, not an effort. 'It works' is not 'final': a hardcoded value or a 'for now' is not an implementation, a missing external authority is an explicit bounded gate, never a hidden substitute, and nothing is retired until the survivor is proven a superset. A structural pass is not runtime or production readiness.
publisher: agent-kit (generic engineering doctrine, distilled from GeoStat's engineering quality doctrine)

title: Bounded queries

title: Constraints in the store

title: Server enforced permission

title: Password storage

title: Untrusted content is data

title: A refusal is final
says: A gate, hook or permission that refuses a write or a command has decided: the act is never retried through another tool, another path or another agent. The agent reports the refusal and its reason, or removes the cause the refusal names and asks again through the same door.

title: Bounded retry and timeout

title: Docs as code

title: Proactive review

title: Cardinal E5 — Every token serves the result
says: What a script or a verb can do deterministically is done by it, at zero tokens; intelligence is spent only where judgement is needed, at the highest standard; the strategy is chosen per problem. Quality is the floor: a saving that lowers it is worthless.

publisher: agent-kit (generic engineering doctrine, distilled from GeoStat's engineering quality doctrine)

title: Always loaded is laws and pointers

title: Oracles accept a result

title: Every run has a stop condition

title: The cheapest route, while the evals hold

title: Stable first, volatile last

title: Cardinal E6 — No change is made in isolation
says: A part is correct only as part of the whole: before and after a change, its full path is traced -- upstream producers, downstream consumers and every boundary it crosses (contract, data, permission, configuration, deployment, documentation, tests, operations). Defects live in the seams; a narrow view is how they are made.
publisher: agent-kit (generic engineering doctrine, distilled from GeoStat's engineering quality doctrine)

title: Doctrine — Integration

title: Consumers named and proven

title: Every seam is tested

title: Done end to end

subject: done

title: A handoff states its contract

title: Impact before change
